classification.difficultyReason: Combine parallel-line relationships, vertically opposite angles, straight angles and triangle angle sums across four diagrams.

content.prompt: Find the values of the pronumerals.

spec.description: Two nearly vertical parallel lines crossed by a gently rising transversal; matching single arrows retained.
spec.mathematics: At the left intersection beta is upper left and alpha lower right. At the right intersection the lower-right angle is 100 degrees.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given 100 degrees and unknown labels appear.

answer.worked:
$\alpha=100^\circ$ (corresponding angles on parallel lines).

$\beta=100^\circ$ (vertically opposite angles).

spec.description: Two horizontal parallel lines and a descending transversal, retaining matching rightward single arrows.
spec.mathematics: The upper lower-right angle is 74 degrees. At the lower crossing beta is upper left, alpha upper right and gamma lower left.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given 74 degrees and unknown labels appear.

answer.worked:
$\beta=74^\circ$ (alternate angles on parallel lines).

$\begin{aligned}\alpha&=180^\circ-74^\circ\\\alpha&=106^\circ\end{aligned}$

Adjacent angles on a straight line are supplementary.

$\gamma=106^\circ$ (vertically opposite angles).

spec.description: Two oblique lines intersect above two gently rising parallel lines. Both oblique lines continue below the lower parallel; both parallel arrows are retained.
spec.mathematics: The top angle at the oblique crossing is 45 degrees and its vertically opposite angle is alpha. At the left upper-parallel crossing, 125 degrees is upper left, beta upper right and phi lower right. At the right crossing gamma is upper left, theta upper right and psi lower left.
spec.answerVisibility: Only 45 degrees, 125 degrees and the six unknown labels appear.

answer.worked:
$\alpha=45^\circ$ (vertically opposite angles).

$\begin{aligned}\beta&=180^\circ-125^\circ\\\beta&=55^\circ\end{aligned}$

Adjacent angles on a straight line are supplementary.

$\phi=125^\circ$ (vertically opposite angles).

$\begin{aligned}\gamma&=180^\circ-45^\circ-55^\circ\\\gamma&=80^\circ\end{aligned}$

Angle sum of a triangle.

$\begin{aligned}\theta&=180^\circ-80^\circ\\\theta&=100^\circ\end{aligned}$

Adjacent angles on a straight line are supplementary.

$\psi=100^\circ$ (vertically opposite angles).

spec.description: Triangle between double-arrow horizontal parallels, with a single-arrow ray from its lower-right vertex parallel to its left side.
spec.mathematics: The apex interior angle is 52 degrees. The rightward ray makes 68 degrees with the base extension. Alpha and beta are the base interior angles; theta is between the descending triangle side and the ray; phi and gamma are below the upper horizontal outside the apex interior angle.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied 52 degrees, 68 degrees, parallel marks and unknown labels appear.

answer.worked:
$\alpha=68^\circ$ (corresponding angles on the single-arrow parallel lines).

$\begin{aligned}\beta&=180^\circ-68^\circ-52^\circ\\\beta&=60^\circ\end{aligned}$

Angle sum of a triangle.

$\theta=52^\circ$ (alternate angles on the single-arrow parallel lines).

$\gamma=60^\circ$ and $\phi=68^\circ$ (alternate angles on the double-arrow parallel lines).
